import sys


def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not tokens:
        return

    n = int(tokens[0])
    area = n * n
    costs = []
    position = 1

    for piece in range(4):
        mismatches = 0
        for row_index in range(n):
            row = tokens[position]
            position += 1
            for column_index, color in enumerate(row):
                expected = 48 + ((row_index + column_index) & 1)
                mismatches += color != expected
        costs.append(mismatches)

    changes = sorted(area - 2 * cost for cost in costs)
    print(sum(costs) + changes[0] + changes[1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
